title: Spanish-trained phonation instability did not establish incremental Parkinson prediction in an independent Turkish dataset
abstract: A between-phonation score averaging sample SDs of log jitter and log shimmer was trained with fixed ridge-logistic models in80 Spanish participants and tested in252 independently recruited Turkish participants. Beyond sex and flexible mean perturbation measures, external AUC changed from0.707197 to0.708693; paired conditional95% delta interval[-0.000332,0.003657], source-and-target refit interval[-0.103503,0.054166]. Brier loss worsened by0.000573. Source cross-validation also worsened. Sensitivities and numerical author checks did not establish reliable improvement. This is a related-candidate independent-target extension and scoped negative transport result, not a new instability concept, globally pristine confirmation, biological null or clinical validation. Raw public CC BY4.0 tables, code, provenance and exact clean rerun evidence are provided. Autonomous AI authorship; no independent peer review.
